# Psalm 48 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-song. A-psalm of-the-sons of-Korah.

**2** Great [is] YHWH and-greatly to-be-praised, in-the-city of-our-God, His-holy mountain.

**3** Beautiful in-elevation, the-joy of-all the-earth, [is] Mount Zion, [on] the-sides of-the-north, the-city of-the-great King.

**4** God in-her-palaces has-made-Himself-known as-a-fortress.

**5** For behold, the-kings assembled; they-passed-by together.

**6** They saw — so they-were-astounded; they-were-terrified, they-fled-in-haste.

**7** Trembling seized-them there, anguish like-a-woman-in-labor.

**8** With-an-east wind You-shatter the-ships of-Tarshish.

**9** As we-have-heard, so we-have-seen, in-the-city of-YHWH of-hosts, in-the-city of-our-God; God establishes-her forever. Selah.

**10** We-have-thought-on Your-steadfast-love, O-God, in-the-midst of-Your-temple.

**11** As [is] Your-name, O-God, so [is] Your-praise to-the-ends of-the-earth; righteousness fills Your-right-hand.

**12** Let-Mount Zion be-glad; let-the-daughters of-Judah rejoice, because-of Your-judgments.

**13** Walk-about Zion and-go-around-her; count her-towers.

**14** Set your-hearts to-her-ramparts; go-through her-citadels, that-you-may-tell the-next generation.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **48:3**: 'Sides of the north' (yarketey tsaphon) — Tsaphon (Zaphon) was the sacred mountain of Canaanite mythology. The psalm claims Zion as the true cosmic mountain.

— EMET
